rationale: The agent correctly verified identity via full name + zip and pulled the correct account and orders. It accurately reported the air purifier’s pending status and, when item-only removal failed, offered appropriate alternatives. It then modified the air purifier to the cheapest available variant correctly and the tool shows the correct refund amount and destination. However, it performed the order-changing write without first stating the exact change (specific variant and price/refund details) and obtaining explicit confirmation, which the policy requires. Additionally, the agent defaulted the refund to the credit card without confirming the user’s preference, despite the presence of a gift card payment method and the tool’s ability to specify a payment method at modification time. Afterward, it declined to redirect the refund. These misses mean the request was not completed fully in line with policy.
